parameters.query: SELECT id, listing_id, channel, copy, image_path, scheduled_for FROM scheduled_posts WHERE status = 'queued' AND scheduled_for <= now() ORDER BY scheduled_for ASC LIMIT 25;
UPDATE scheduled_posts SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, status;

meta.description: Cron (5 min). Pulls scheduled_posts WHERE status='queued' AND scheduled_for<=now(). For each, POSTs the post body to the per-channel webhook URL set via PINTEREST_WEBHOOK_URL / X_WEBHOOK_URL / INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL (e.g. Buffer, Make.com, or another n8n workflow). If no URL is configured for a channel, the post is moved to status='ready_for_export' so the operator can post manually from the dashboard.
